messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: lattice-perturbation search around scaled grid points

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "A lattice-perturbation search starting from a 4×4 grid with one interior point removed (12 boundary/corner-adjacent points plus one shifted interior point) will achieve a minimum triangle area exceeding 0.0115, with the optimal configuration placing the removed interior point near coordinates (0.5, 0.5) and perturbing the remaining 12 points by approximately 0.02–0.05 away from their lattice positions to equalize the smallest triangle areas."}
